changes: Google Drive Sync now detects local file previews and directs users to the published HTTPS Sonata site before attempting OAuth.
This prevents Google’s misleading Error 400 authorization screen when Sonata is opened directly from disk or inside an unsupported embedded browser.
whatsNew: Drive Sync now starts only from a valid web origin.

changes: Corrected the 1.5.1 desktop layout: Virtual Piano, full-width Fretboard, and Reference Tuner are now separate rows so the complete guitar neck stays usable.
Reduced the desktop Circle of Fifths to a contained reference size, while retaining its readable controls and mobile-safe layout.
Repaired Google Drive sign-in handling by removing duplicate OAuth click requests and showing Google account selection on a new connection.
Sidebar navigation now closes after a destination is chosen, leaving the selected workspace unobstructed.
Removed interface click sounds and added output limiting plus gentler Circle chord levels to prevent harsh or clipped playback.
whatsNew: A corrective release focused on dependable Drive sign-in, responsive instrument space, quieter controls, and safe audio levels.

changes: Standardized the desktop Play workspace: Virtual Piano and Fretboard now sit side by side, so both instruments are visible immediately instead of being buried in a long vertical stack.
Improved instrument card spacing, sizing, and horizontal scroll treatment while retaining piano, fretboard, tuner, key highlighting, and tuning controls.
Expanded the Circle of Fifths into a larger desktop reference layout with controls placed beside it for easier reading.
Restored desktop access to the full sidebar menu, including Settings, About Sonata, language, sync, presentation, and install actions.
Fixed view isolation so each Sonata workspace displays only its active page.
whatsNew: A cleaner desktop workspace: larger theory reference, visible instruments, and complete navigation from every screen.

changes: Responsive Layout: Tablet & mobile navigation collapse under 1024px into a slide-out drawer, with a dedicated mobile Google Sync status pill.
Desktop & Laptop Full Viewport IDE: Split editor and preview panes stretch to fill 100% of the viewport height with zero wasted space and independent internal scrolling.
Interactive Syntax Quick-Start: Clickable syntax chips in empty editor to quickly insert headers, chords, dividers, and rehearsal notes with instant preview.
Metadata Chips: Replaced plain text author/arranger/key bar with sleek, formatted metadata tag chips.
Live Status Indicator: Dynamic status badge with a live dot reflecting Saved (green), Autosaving (pulsing blue), and Editing (amber) states.
Chart Preview Polish: Fixed text wrapping in chart empty state, replaced plain emoji with modern SVG illustrations, and added thin custom desktop scrollbars.
Destructive Action Confirmations: Safe modal dialogs before deleting songs, loading demos, or clearing unsaved charts.
Unsaved Changes Guard: Browser beforeunload warning and in-app navigation dialog (Save & Leave, Discard, Cancel) preventing accidental loss of work.
Toast Notification System: Modern, non-blocking bottom-center toast alerts for save, cloud sync, export, transposition, and song deletion.
Stage Presentation Polish: Floating, high-visibility 'Exit Presentation' button with 3-second auto-fade, plus keyboard shortcut hints.
Mobile Transpose Stepper: Intuitive minus/plus stepper controls for mobile screens alongside the transpose slider.

Accessibility & Contrast (WCAG AA): High-contrast active tab styling in dark mode, visible keyboard focus rings, descriptive ARIA labels across all icon buttons, and 44px minimum touch targets on metronome controls.
Transpose Undo Stack: Integrated chord transposition into the 50-step undo/redo history stack.
Cross-Platform Shortcut Hints: Dynamically detects macOS (⌘S, ⌘Z) vs Windows/Linux (Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Z) for keyboard shortcuts, with a global Cmd/Ctrl+S save listener.
whatsNew: Comprehensive UI/UX overhaul: desktop & laptop full-height split IDE, interactive syntax quick-start, metadata chips, live status badge, unsaved changes protection, destructive action modals, and mobile responsive navigation.

changes: AI Action UI: Actions now securely execute UI commands with a new 'Undo' functionality.
Inline UI Confirmations: Safely clear your AI chat history without disruptive browser popups.
Smarter Gemini: The AI Co-Writer now perfectly understands all Sonata app features, settings, and navigation.
AI UX Polish: Modern Bot icon replaced the generic stars, and settings bugs were fixed.
whatsNew: AI UI bugfixes, 'Undo' AI actions, and a smarter Co-Writer system prompt.

changes: AI Co-Writer: Generate chords, format lyrics, and automate the UI directly via chat.
Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): Add your own free Google Gemini API key for unlimited AI access.
AI Settings UI: Easily manage your AI API key and fallback settings.
Enhanced About Sonata page with feature accordions and updated UI.
whatsNew: AI Co-Writer with BYOK support and automated UI controls.

changes: Personalized profile greeting (Hi, [First Name]! e.g., Hi, Jethro!) with instant local caching.
Mobile & Tablet Editor view switcher: Edit, Preview, and Split mode toggling.
Full position and view persistence across page refreshes.
Direct ultra-shortened song/setlist sharing links without external URL shorteners.
Official embedded QR code generator for camera scanning in PNG & PDF exports.
Universal PWA app installation prompt across iOS, Android, and Desktop.
Enhanced responsive design for tablet, desktop, and mobile viewports.
whatsNew: Instant view persistence on refresh, mobile Edit/Preview mode toggle, and personalized user profile greetings.

changes: Ultra-shortened, direct song and setlist share links without external shorteners.
Embedded QR codes for fast camera scanning in PNG and PDF exports.
Google account profile greeting (Hi, [Name]) and persistent avatar display.
Precise timestamps with date and time on all song modifications.
Manual key override mode for Virtual Piano and Fretboard without automatic resets.
Seamless offline-first PWA caching and instant Google Drive auto-sync.
Enhanced responsive navigation across mobile, tablet, and desktop views.
whatsNew: Direct links with embedded QR code exports, user profile greetings, precise timestamps, and full cross-device responsiveness.

changes: Responsive sidebar drawer navigation for mobile and tablet screens.
Full offline Service Worker pre-caching for PWA installations.
Google account name auto-fill for the Arranger field.
Removed unnecessary toast notifications from instrument panels.
Optimized layout and whitespace for all screen sizes.
Official Sonata logo in the navbar.
whatsNew: Cleaner responsive layout with a slide-out navigation menu and true offline compatibility.

changes: Multi-language localization support (English & Filipino).
Manual key overrides and interactive Capo settings.
Guitar Capo support with transposed preview labels.
App versioning and internationalization.
Initial release of Sonata.
Offline interactive chords editor, virtual piano, fretboard, and tuner.
Google Drive sync and zero-friction QR code sharing.
Circle of Fifths, Nashville Numbers, and Roman Numeral support.
whatsNew: Initial release of the offline tool for musicians.
